name: parkercommits
description: Claude plugins by Parker Lyons. Includes PMM Framework, a Product Marketing Director agent; ADHD Coach, a pocket ADHD coach; and PM Interview Coach, an adaptive job-interview coach.

plugins.name: pmm-framework
plugins.description: A Product Marketing Director agent: guided setup and PMM health check, then research, strategy, positioning, launches, and post-launch growth, built on the PMA framework with MKT1 practices.

plugins.name: adhd-coach
plugins.description: A pocket ADHD coach: a strengths-first onboarding builds a private Manual of Me that every coaching skill reads, so help fits how you work and arrives when you get stuck.

plugins.name: pm-interview-coach
plugins.description: An adaptive interview coach: prep briefs with interviewer research, five-dimension scoring of transcripts and practice, a storybank with earned secrets, mocks, debriefs and offer negotiation, with a private Coaching State that carries across chats.
